name: Basseiah
title: Levite in David's time
summary: Basseiah is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a Levite in the lineage of those who served in the temple. He was the son of Malchijah and part of the Levitical line responsible for the music service in God's house during King David's reign.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of the Levites
keyEvents.description: Basseiah is listed in the genealogy of the Levites who served with song in the tabernacle, as part of Asaph's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Part of the music service in the tabernacle
keyEvents.description: Basseiah belonged to the Levitical line appointed by David to lead praise and worship in the house of the Lord after the ark of the covenant found its place.

keyEvents.title: Lineage through Asaph
keyEvents.description: Through his lineage, Basseiah was connected to the renowned singer and psalmist Asaph, who served at the ark of the covenant.

keyEvents.title: The service of the Levites under David
keyEvents.description: David organized the service of the Levites, including the line of Basseiah, for song and music in the worship of God.
